versions.content: Transformers not executed when queue is empty and execut- eDespiteDataUnavailability is disabled Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00247 The RTE shall not execute the transformers for queued (event semantics) sender- receiver communication when the queue is empty (because no data are available) if executeDespiteDataUnavailability of DataTransformation is disabled and the Rte_Receive API has non-blocking characteristics according to [SWS_Rte_01288].
